title: Battle of Paete
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Paete", at revision 1370452608, opens: "The Battle of Paete was a small battle fought between American forces, commanded by General Henry W. Lawton, and Philippine nationalists on April 12, 1899, during the Philippine–American War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871969, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1899 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
